frontend: PCSX2 standalone, isolated -datapath; input from an SDL3 virtual gamepad (sdlpad.dylib)
how: ad-hoc re-signed copy of the app (no hardened runtime) so DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES works; the retro-run script is expanded per frame and stepped once per PCSX2 input poll (per vsync) from VM start; shots via the Screenshot hotkey; 5 s after the script PCSX2 gets SIGINT, its clean exit (VM shut down, cards closed, NVRAM saved)
data_root: the -datapath folder's PCSX2/ (memcards/, bios/); paths below are relative to it
proof: PCSX2's own screenshot (last `shot`), RGBA 1280x960 converted to RGB 640x480
